text_1: Some of the common challenges that prevent brands from orchestrating and delivering a truly seamless and personal customer journey include that they lack a single organizational truth on the customer experience for managing marketing programs and customer service engagement. They likely did not have a way of integrating all data sources across the customer experience to create the single source of truth. With disconnected MarTech applications, they often also have disparate teams and processes that make it difficult to manage the customer journey holistically.
text_2: Whether you’re composing push notifications, in-app messages, SMS text messages, or even email, you can do it all from a single application. Creating personalized push notifications is a great way to drive engagement with your app, and you can even customize the desired action you want customers to take. Journey Optimizer can personalize in-app messages based on profile attributes, app usage history, and device location to help you go from a one-size-fits-all app experience to a rich, context-aware experience.

text_2: We will discuss how to test a journey containing an in-app, and then with the actual journey publication.
